title: Brother Osk gives an explicit, unambiguous ultimatum after the first hold I burned: 'If it happens again, I'm gone — I mean that, and I don't say things like that lightly.' I burned two more hollows afterward (Iron Downs' Hundred Gallery, then Wardmoor's oath-stone) and his regard just sat at -2 'near leaving' both times — the promised departure never fired.
where: The Burned Glade (Thornwold) warning; The Hundred Gallery — Ash and The Oath-Ground — Circle (Wardmoor) are where it should have triggered and didn't
